purpose: Recommend an action or advise against it.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
た-form + ほうがいい; ない-form + ほうがいい.
You should go to bed early today.
You should ask the teacher once.
formation: た-form + ほうがいい; ない-form + ほうがいい.
restrictions: Direct advice can sound strong; soften it when appropriate.
mistake: た before positive advice does not place the recommended action in the past.
